alt.en: A large globe with teal meridians stands at the center of a gray floor. A dashed orange line runs from an orange packet cube on the left to the globe, then continues with an arrowhead into a teal floor area with a dashed edge on the right.
alt.zh: 灰色地面中央立着一个带青绿色经线的大地球仪。一条橙色虚线从左侧的橙色数据包方块通到地球仪，再带着箭头延伸进右侧一块虚线围边的青绿色地面区域。

caption.en: Illustration: a session request, drawn as an orange packet, travels by way of a globe standing for Kiro's cloud sessions into a marked zone standing for a customer's private network, as Kiro describes the feature. It does not depict a tested deployment, and it does not show Kiro's actual routing or network controls.
caption.zh: 示意图：按照 Kiro 的描述，橙色数据包代表的会话请求经由象征 Kiro 云端会话的地球仪，进入代表客户私有网络的划定区域。图中描绘的并非经过测试的部署，也不反映 Kiro 的实际路由或网络控制措施。

links.note: ends at a floor point inside the zone, since a zone has no outline for a link to meet
